notes: James E. Gordon Color Slide Collection of San Francisco Murals (SFP 90) — every record is a mural, photographed 1976-1984. The address is where the mural was, so the finding is about the mural rather than about the building, and the description says so. 78 records credit a mural artist in 700 $e; exactly one of those also gives a street number.

coverage.remaining: None. The collection was read whole.
coverage.note: 285 records read; 51 give an exact street number; 232 give none and were skipped, being "Mural at <street> near <street>" — a corner, not a building. 14 findings over 14 distinct addresses; 11 resolved, 3 unresolved (255 Columbus Avenue, which joins no parcel; 80 N. 5th Street, a street the register does not have; 55 Laguna Street, a condominium).

resolution.method: sf-eas-addresses has 55 LAGUNA ST but it does not join to one parcel. 55 LAGUNA ST's coordinates fall in 5 active parcels (0857002, 0857004, 0857005, 0857006…), which is what a condominium looks like in sf-parcels: one parcel per unit, none of them the building.
resolution.note: The address is a condominium today, and the directory contract in the root AGENTS.md defers those: each unit has its own parcel and none of them is the building the record names.
